job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. As DayOne's footprint grows across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, the client relationships behind that infrastructure need the same level of accountability as the build itself — this role owns that.

Across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Hong Kong, DayOne operates some of the region's most active hyperscale campuses — from Johor's largest LEED-certified data center footprint to Thailand's build toward its first 1GW platform. This role can be based in any of these markets, working alongside local delivery teams on live client accounts.

About the Role

You'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers across project delivery and ongoing service operations, owning outcomes from initial construction through to live SLA performance. This is a senior, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of project management, technical delivery, and client relationship management. You'll lead virtual delivery teams, manage the full lifecycle of data center construction and customization projects, and be accountable for service quality once the facility is live.

Client Relationship and Delivery Ownership

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers across all aspects of project delivery and ongoing service operations.
  • Build trust-based client relationships and act as a strategic advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Manage service delivery in line with SLAs and agreed delivery costs, leading a virtual delivery team to drive customer satisfaction.

Project Delivery

  • Lead data center construction and customization projects end to end, working closely with Sales, Presales, Design, Construction, and Testing and Commissioning teams.
  • Manage project schedules, quality, costs, risks, and escalations through to timely closure and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate internal resources for both project implementation and service operations in line with company standards and customer requirements.

Service Operations and Continuous Improvement

  • Manage SLA performance and customer satisfaction during the ongoing operations phase, working with data center operations, network, and IT service teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement and proactive risk mitigation across live service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with internal processes including procurement, audit requirements, and ITIL standards.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 7 or more years of experience in the data center industry, MEP consultancy, or construction, with direct exposure to project delivery and client management.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure, ITIL frameworks, and SLA management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects across the full delivery lifecycle, from construction through to live operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English, required for client and stakeholder engagement across DayOne's Mandarin-speaking customer base.

Soft Skills

  • Manages client relationships with the credibility of a trusted advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Mediates competing priorities and stakeholder conflicts without losing sight of the customer outcome.
  • Communicates clearly in writing, producing reports and updates that keep clients and internal teams aligned without follow-up questions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing hyperscale or mission-critical data center accounts across multiple markets simultaneously.
  • Exposure to cross-border or multi-entity service delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with data center construction customization and handover processes.

Why DayOne? DayOne is expanding fast across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, and this role sits at the center of how that expansion lands with clients. You'll own the full relationship, from construction through to live SLA performance, work across some of the most technically demanding infrastructure in the region, and have real cross-functional scope from day one.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Senior Director, Customer Success
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Director, Customer Success to lead our global customer organization. Reporting to the SVP, Customer Success, this executive will own the entire customer lifecycle for one of our hyperscale customers — from onboarding and service activation through adoption, retention, renewal, and expansion — across every region in which we operate.

As a global provider of mission-critical data center capacity, our customers depend on us for uptime, capacity, and the operational partnership that keeps their infrastructure running at scale. The VP of Customer Success will be the executive owner of that relationship: the leader accountable for customer health, retention of recurring revenue, and the trusted-advisor relationships that turn large deployments into multi-year, multi-region partnerships. This is a builder's role for a leader who can operate at the C-suite of the world's largest cloud companies while scaling the team, playbooks, and systems that deliver a consistent experience worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

  • Own the global customer success strategy and translate it into regional operating plans, ensuring a consistent, high-touch experience across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Build, scale, and mentor a distributed team of customer success managers, technical account managers, and onboarding specialists across multiple regions and time zones.
  • Serve as a member of the commercial leadership team, partnering with Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance to align on customer priorities and revenue outcomes.

Retention, Renewals & Growth

  • Own gross and net revenue retention for the global customer base; drive renewals of large, long-term capacity contracts and minimize churn and non-renewal risk.
  • Partner with Sales to identify and drive expansion — additional capacity, new markets, interconnection, and value-added services — within strategic hyperscale and cloud accounts.
  • Develop account and portfolio-level success plans that map customer growth roadmaps to available and future capacity.

Customer Lifecycle & Experience

  • Own onboarding and service activation, ensuring smooth, on-time delivery from contract execution through power-on and go-live.
  • Establish a customer health framework and early-warning system using adoption, operational, and sentiment signals to proactively manage risk.
  • Act as the senior executive escalation point for critical customer issues, coordinating closely with Data Center Operations during incidents and service events.
  • Lead executive business reviews (EBRs / QBRs) with C-level and infrastructure leaders at the world's largest cloud providers.

Operations & Voice of the Customer

  • Define the customer success operating model, KPIs, and tooling; instrument the function with clear metrics and reporting for the executive team and board.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer to Product, Engineering, and Operations, channeling feedback into service, SLA, and roadmap improvements.
  • Own commercial and operational governance of SLAs, uptime commitments, and service credits in partnership with Legal and Operations.

##

Qualifications & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in customer success, account management, service delivery, or commercial leadership, including 7+ years leading teams at a senior/executive level.
  • Proven track record owning retention and net revenue retention for a large, recurring-revenue B2B portfolio, ideally with enterprise contract values in the millions.
  • Deep experience serving hyperscale, cloud, or large enterprise infrastructure customers — you understand how these organizations buy, operate, and scale.
  • Strong domain knowledge of data centers, colocation, cloud infrastructure, or mission-critical facilities (power, cooling, capacity, interconnection, uptime/SLAs).
  • Experience building and leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
  • Executive presence and credibility with C-suite and senior infrastructure stakeholders; able to lead high-stakes commercial conversations and escalations.
  • Data-driven operator comfortable with customer success tooling, health scoring, and forecasting; balances high-touch relationships with scalable process.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent leadership experience preferred. Willingness to travel internationally.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Treasury Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Role Overview

As the Treasury Manager, you will play a critical role in securing financing and managing treasury operation across DayOne’s footprint. Reporting to Senior Regional Treasury Manager, you will have exposure to regional and cross border financing transactions in supporting DayOne’s growth in the digital infrastructure and sustainability space. With opportunity to shape financing solutions and treasury practices for a growing data center platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the structuring and execution of project finance, corporate loans, revolving credit facilities, green or sustainability-linked financing. Maintaining relationships with banking partners and investors.
  • Prepare and coordinate lender presentations, information memoranda, due diligence materials, financing models, debt capacity analyses and funding scenarios.
  • Coordinate financing transactions from mandate to financial close, including term sheets, facility agreements, intercreditor arrangements and security documents.
  • Monitor conditions precedent and subsequent, financial covenants, compliance certificates, lender reporting obligations and key financing deadlines.
  • Support liquidity planning and the management of interest rate and foreign exchange risks, including hedging execution and documentation.
  • Perform any other tasks as assigned from time-to-time, ensuring flexibility and adaptability to support the organization's evolving needs and priorities.

Candidate Profile:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.
  • 5-7 years’ hands-on experience executing debt financing and working directly with banks or financial institutions.
  • Strong knowledge of project finance, loan documentation, credit analysis, financing covenants, financial modelling and treasury risk management.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; treasury systems or Bloomberg exposure is advantageous.
  • Professional qualifications such as CFA, CTP, ACT/AMCT, CPA or ACCA are advantageous.
  • Strong commercial judgement, analytical ability, attention to detail, negotiation skills and confidence engaging senior stakeholders across jurisdictions.

job.title: Engineer, QA QC
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

The Engineer, QA/QC ensures site compliance with approved quality processes, project requirements, and company standards, driving quality performance and supporting the successful delivery of mission-critical data center projects through inspections, audits, and quality data analysis

Key Responsibilities

Work Process & Scope Compliance**

  • Verify that site QA/QC processes follow the approved work process, method statements, mock-ups and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) for every activity.
  • Audit field teams to ensure hold points and witness points are not bypassed and that required signoffs are obtained in sequence.

Quality Control Execution

  • Surveillance and monitoring, track, and close Inspection Requests (IRs/RFIs), Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and Site Issue Reports where the process or scope is not met.
  • Verify that site construction QA/QC maintain complete and accurate quality records, ITP signoffs, test packs, and turnover documentation.

Data Collation, Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform basic data crunching and analysis (e.g., NCR counts by trade/contractor/system, first-time-right rates, repeat-defect frequency, inspection pass/fail ratios, etc).
  • Identify emerging trends, recurring issues, and problem areas from the data, and flag them to the QA/QC Manager for action.
  • Prepare clear, data-supported daily/weekly quality reports, dashboards, and NCR statistics for the project location (Campus Level).
  • Capture and document lessons learned at project level and feed them into the database for sharing across projects.

Commissioning & Critical Systems Compliance

  • Verify that L1–L5 commissioning activities (FAT, SAT, pre-functional, functional, IST) are executed per the approved commissioning process.
  • Confirm installation quality and process compliance for UPS, generators, switchgear, busway, CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling distribution, and fire detection/suppression.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of QA/QC experience in construction; data center, mission-critical, or MEP-intensive projects strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ITPs, NCRs, work-process compliance, commissioning, defects management and quality documentation systems.
  • Competence in data handling and analysis using Excel (pivot tables, charts) or equivalent tools; familiarity with dashboards a plus.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and relevant construction/data center standards.
  • Certifications (preferred): CQI/CSWIP, NDT, CWI, CxA, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and quality/document control platforms (ACC, Procore, Aconex, BIM 360).

Competencies Attention to detail, field inspection and audit discipline, analytical mindset, firm enforcement of process and scope under schedule pressure, and effective communication across multidisciplinary site teams. Comfortable to be based on-site.

Job Description

  • Hands-on in executing payment transactions, managing funding movements, and performing intercompany settlements.
  • Provide hands-on support for bank account openings, KYC processes, mandate updates, and ongoing bank documentation requirements.
  • Prepare regular treasury reports for management, including cash balance positions, cash forecasts, hedging reports, and other related analyses.
  • Prepare audit support materials and liaise with auditors to fulfill necessary requests during the year-end audit.
  • Update internal treasury policies and process manuals to meet SOX and internal control requirements.

Requirements

  • Professional qualification is an added advantage (e.g., ACCA, CPA, CIMA, CFA Level)

  • Exposure to SOX/internal controls compliance is preferred.
  • Practical experience with ERP systems (SAP / S4 HANA / Oracle) and online banking platforms.
